description: Official Claude Code plugin marketplace for Skill Heaven: live, on-demand ephemeral skill summoning, a clean-room session launcher, and honest, relevance-ranked discovery. Output is reference data; rung meaning is still provisional.

plugins.name: skill-heaven
plugins.description: Skill Heaven is live. Summon one skill into a session with nothing installed: manual /summon at every rung, a clean-room launcher floor (/skill-zero), converge and explore bands over one relevance-ranked summon (/skill-heaven, /skill-hell), and the crown rung (/skill-ultra), from a Skill Tree or a flat GitHub repository. Its output is reference data, never standing authority; what each rung means in behaviour is still provisional.
